messages.author: Suchetana Gupta
messages.body:
Hi
I have been using Amber extensively in my previous institution and had a
thoroughly enjoyable experience. At my present institution we are trying to
set things up and were looking to get a copy of Amber 20 (or any older
version). However due to fund crunch, we have requested for a waiver at the
designated email address.
Unfortunately we have not received a response.
Just wanted to check if that waiver scheme is still valid or not.
Thanks
Suchetana Gupta
Research Associate
IACS, Kolkata, INDIA
